Coaching

How you start matters more than you think.

Most founders rush into opportunities, following trends and intuition without fully seeing what could go wrong. The result is wasted time, money, and energy on products that never find traction. I'm guilty of this too!

Building a product is easy. Building a product that people love is not. You can choose the wrong customer, solve the wrong problem, build the wrong proposition, or try to scale before the foundations are ready.

As a coach, my role is to help founders identify and address those risks early (while they're still cheap to fix) so they can grow with more confidence and resilience. I work with founders to make better product and growth decisions by thinking risk-first.

Audience fit

Are you solving the right problem for the right people?

Clarify who you're building for, understand what they actually need, and test the assumptions that matter before committing significant time and money.

Value fit

Are you building something people will genuinely value?

Work through the proposition, priorities and product decisions that determine whether what gets built actually solves the problem well.

Growth fit

Are you ready to grow, and are you growing the right way?

Identify what is driving or blocking adoption, use evidence to prioritise what matters, and build a more deliberate path to growth.

How I work

The goal is never to eliminate all risks, but to understand them and manage them effectively.

We identify the outcome you're trying to achieve and what could prevent it, prioritise the risks that matter most, and decide how to move forward in a way that improves your odds.
